paragraphs.text: Drakuseth , also known as the Maw of Flames , is a legendary dragon from Shiv on Dominaria .

Drakuseth is a character introduced in Core Set 2020 . It is a particularly huge Shivan dragon with black scales and an explosive fire breath. It is responsible for the death of Marsden , an experienced party leader in Shiv, whose party failed to spread out enough when facing the dragon. To represent this, the spread of its flame, whenever Drakuseth attacks, it deals 4 damage to an additional target and 3 damage to 3 additional targets.
